sourceNote: Provider x credential-family taxonomy (issue #502). Grounded in benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts contract review text and benchmarks/detectors.json; every entry with an empty detectors list carries a source or note explaining why it is not detector-covered. Consumed by A2 (#503) and A3 (#504); zero-detector families become `unsupported` candidates in A8's support-matrix.json (#509).

families.name: IAM user access key
families.description: Long-term access key ID for an IAM user, prefixed AKIA.

families.name: STS temporary access key
families.description: Short-lived access key ID issued by AWS STS, prefixed ASIA; requires an accompanying session token.
families.note: aws-access-key's pattern is anchored to AKIA only (benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts contract), so ASIA values are not matched. classifyFixture already special-cases a bare AWS positive as policy, not must-redact, because "some legacy ASIA values also use digits outside the base32 alphabet".

families.name: STS service bearer token
families.description: AWS STS service-issued bearer credential, prefixed ABIA.
families.note: Documented in the same IAM unique-identifier prefix table as AKIA/ASIA; not matched by the AKIA-only pattern.

families.name: Context-specific credential
families.description: Context-specific temporary credential, prefixed ACCA.
families.note: Documented in the same IAM unique-identifier prefix table as AKIA/ASIA; not matched by the AKIA-only pattern.

families.name: IAM user secret access key
families.description: The 40-character secret paired with an IAM user access key ID. Has no distinguishing prefix or lexical marker.
families.note: The aws-access-key contract's companion field states a separate 40-character secret access key is required alongside the access key ID; this project has no dedicated detector for the secret half, which carries no stable prefix to anchor on.

families.name: Classic personal access token
families.description: Classic PAT, prefixed ghp_.

families.name: OAuth access token
families.description: OAuth app access token, prefixed gho_.

families.name: GitHub App user-to-server token
families.description: GitHub App user-to-server token, prefixed ghu_.

families.name: GitHub App server-to-server token
families.description: GitHub App installation (server-to-server) token, prefixed ghs_.

families.name: OAuth refresh token
families.description: OAuth app refresh token, prefixed ghr_.

families.name: Fine-grained personal access token
families.description: Repository- and permission-scoped PAT, prefixed github_pat_.
families.note: Named explicitly in issue #502 as a family the github-token detector does not cover: its pattern only matches the ghp_/gho_/ghu_/ghs_/ghr_ underscore-plus-36-character-body shape, which github_pat_ does not fit.

families.name: Legacy personal access token
families.description: Legacy-format PAT, prefixed glpat- with a 20-character body.

families.name: Routable personal access token
families.description: Newer routable PAT format described on the same token-prefix page.
families.note: gitlab-token's contract review states explicitly that routable tokens are not covered by the 20-character-body pattern.

families.name: Secret API key
families.description: sk- prefixed secret API key, including project- and service-account-scoped variants (sk-proj-, sk-svcacct-).

families.name: Secret API key
families.description: sk-ant- prefixed secret API key.

families.name: Custom app access token
families.description: Access token for a store-installed custom app, prefixed shpat_.

families.name: Public app access token
families.description: Access token for a public/listed app, prefixed shppa_.

families.name: Service token
families.description: Standard Vault service token, prefixed hvs.

families.name: Batch token
families.description: Lightweight, non-renewable Vault batch token, prefixed hvb.

families.name: Recovery token
families.description: Vault recovery operation token, prefixed hvr.

families.name: Live secret key
families.description: Live-mode secret key, prefixed sk_live_.

families.name: Test secret key
families.description: Test-mode secret key, prefixed sk_test_.

families.name: Live restricted key
families.description: Live-mode restricted-permission key, prefixed rk_live_.

families.name: Test restricted key
families.description: Test-mode restricted-permission key, prefixed rk_test_.

families.name: Organization API key
families.description: Organization-scoped secret key, prefixed sk_org_.
sources: benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts (classifyFixture variant guard: "Variant support must not be inferred from a related family name.")
families.note: classifyFixture explicitly routes sk_org_ values to "this variant needs a separate format contract; related detector support is not evidence of parity", so it is not claimed by stripe-token's live/test secret-key pattern.

families.name: Webhook signing secret
families.description: Webhook endpoint signing secret, prefixed whsec_.
sources: benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts (classifyFixture variant guard: "Variant support must not be inferred from a related family name.")
families.note: Same classifyFixture guard as the organization API key covers whsec_ values; stripe-token's pattern does not match them.

families.name: Bot token
families.description: Bot user OAuth token, prefixed xoxb-.

families.name: User token
families.description: User OAuth token, prefixed xoxp-.
families.note: slack-token's contract lists xoxp- among the provider-documented prefixes but its pattern only matches xoxb-.

families.name: App-level token
families.description: App-level token, prefixed xapp-.
families.note: Documented alongside xoxb- in the same provider prefix table; not matched by the bot-token-only pattern.

families.name: Workflow webhook token
families.description: Workflow webhook trigger token, prefixed xwfp-.
sources: benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts (classifyFixture variant guard: "Variant support must not be inferred from a related family name.")
families.note: classifyFixture explicitly routes xwfp- values to the "needs a separate format contract" guard.

families.name: API token
families.description: pypi- prefixed base64-encoded macaroon.

families.name: API token
families.description: hf_ prefixed access token.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: Personal access token, prefixed dckr_pat_.

families.name: OAuth access token
families.description: OAuth access token, prefixed dckr_oat_.

families.name: Scannable API token
families.description: cfut_ prefixed scannable API token format.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: Personal access token, prefixed dop_v1_.

families.name: OAuth token
families.description: OAuth token, prefixed doo_v1_.

families.name: Refresh token
families.description: Refresh token, prefixed dor_v1_.

families.name: Personal API key
families.description: Personal API key, prefixed lin_api_.

families.name: OAuth access token
families.description: OAuth access token, prefixed lin_oauth_.
sources: benchmarks/lib/assessment.ts (classifyFixture variant guard: "Variant support must not be inferred from a related family name.")
families.note: classifyFixture explicitly routes lin_oauth_ values to the "needs a separate format contract; related detector support is not evidence of parity" guard.

families.name: Project secret key
families.description: Project-scoped secret API key, prefixed sb_secret_.
families.note: supabase-token's contract is T0/pending: the provider documents the sb_secret_ prefix but not the body shape, so this family has no stable positive contract yet even though a detector targets it.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: Management-API personal access token, prefixed sbp_/sbp_v0_.
families.note: #81 backfilled the supabase-management-token detector (redact-secret#535). Deliberately independent of supabase:secret-key's evidence, per https://github.com/redact-secret/redact-secret/blob/de6add470321f40d7b1cb36808d9f4559e6c2e99/docs/decisions/2026-09-20-scope-supabase-management-token-and-secret-key-independence.md.

families.name: Access token
families.description: Vercel REST API access token.
families.note: vercel-token is T0/pending: the REST API reference documents no token prefix, and the corpus's five candidate vcp_/vci_/vca_/vcr_/vck_ shapes are unconfirmed against provider documentation, so they are not split into separate families here.

families.name: Granular access token
families.description: 2021-09 format token with a Base62 CRC32 checksum, prefixed npm_.

families.name: Legacy token
families.description: Pre-2021 unprefixed UUID-format token.
families.note: npm-token's own provider source is the changelog announcing the npm_ prefix scheme as a replacement, implying the prior UUID-format token predates it; that legacy shape is not matched by the npm_-prefixed pattern.

families.name: Generic API key
families.description: AIza prefixed general-purpose API key.

families.name: OAuth2 credential
families.description: OAuth2 client secret, access token or refresh token.
families.note: google-api-key's contract review notes the pinned TruffleHog detectors separately cover Gemini and OAuth2 credentials, not this generic AIza API-key shape.

families.name: API key
families.description: SG. prefixed API key (full-access and restricted-access permission scopes share this format).

families.name: Application client secret
families.description: Client secret value for an app registration, with a digit+Q~ marker.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: 84-character PAT with a fixed AZDO signature at positions 76-80.

families.name: Legacy integration token
families.description: secret_ prefixed integration token.

families.name: Integration token
families.description: ntn_ prefixed integration token from Notion's 2024-09 rollout.
families.note: notion-token's contract review states this current ntn_-prefixed format has no contract here; the pinned gitleaks rule targets it instead of the legacy secret_ shape.

families.name: API token
families.description: ATAT prefixed API token (minimum-length contract; Atlassian disclaims a fixed length).

families.name: Access token
families.description: ATCT prefixed access token.
families.note: atlassian-api-token's contract review states the pinned TruffleHog detector targets the distinct ATCT access-token family, not the ATAT-prefixed API-token shape.

families.name: Account auth token
families.description: 32-character lowercase-hex account auth token.

families.name: API key secret
families.description: 32-character API key secret.

families.name: Bot token
families.description: digits:secret bot token.

families.name: Bot token
families.description: Three-segment base64url bot token.

families.name: User auth token
families.description: sntryu_ prefixed personal auth token.

families.name: Organization auth token
families.description: sntrys_ prefixed organization auth token.

families.name: API key
families.description: 32-character API key.

families.name: Application key
families.description: 40-character application key.

families.name: Service account token
families.description: glsa_ prefixed service account token.

families.name: Cloud access policy token
families.description: glc_ prefixed Cloud access policy token.

families.name: User API key
families.description: NRAK- prefixed user API key.

families.name: License key
families.description: 40-character hexadecimal license key.

families.name: Legacy FCM server key
families.description: Legacy Firebase Cloud Messaging HTTP/XMPP server key: literal AAAA prefix, 7 bytes, a literal ":", then 140 bytes.
families.note: #81 backfilled the firebase-server-key detector (redact-secret#543). Service-account JSON exports and AIza-prefixed keys are covered elsewhere (private-key, google-api-key), not this family.

families.name: User token
families.description: HCP Terraform/Enterprise user API token, 14 alphanumeric bytes, the literal .atlasv1. marker, then 67 alphanumeric bytes.

families.name: Organization token
families.description: HCP Terraform/Enterprise organization API token; identical grammar to the user token.

families.name: Team token
families.description: HCP Terraform/Enterprise team API token; identical grammar to the user token.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: Pulumi Cloud personal access token, prefixed pul-.

families.name: Organization access token
families.description: Pulumi Cloud organization access token; identical grammar to the personal token.

families.name: Team access token
families.description: Pulumi Cloud team access token; identical grammar to the personal token.

families.name: PEM-encoded private key
families.description: RFC 7468 textual encoding of private key material (any algorithm), not tied to a single provider.

families.name: JSON Web Token
families.description: RFC 7519 compact-serialization token, not tied to a single issuer.

families.name: Bearer credential
families.description: RFC 6750 Authorization: Bearer value; a transport scheme, not a provider-specific format.

families.name: Connection-string password
families.description: Password embedded in a URI's userinfo component per RFC 3986.

families.name: OTP seed
families.description: Base32 secret parameter of an otpauth:// key URI.

families.name: Unclassified assignment literal
families.description: Arbitrary literal in a sensitive-looking assignment, masked as project policy rather than a provider format.

families.name: Personal access token
families.description: dapi-prefixed 32-hex personal access token, optionally suffixed -<digit> after rotation.
families.note: redact-secret#308 (product PR #665) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6; the pinned published package predates it. OAuth client secrets are a separately documented scope extension, not this family.

families.name: Cloud API secret (cflt-prefixed)
families.description: API secret created after 2025-07-30: literal cflt prefix, then 60 base64-body bytes, the last 6 a CRC32 checksum.
families.note: redact-secret#309 (product PR #667) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6; the pinned published package predates it. The API key ID ("not considered secret information") is never a positive.

families.name: Cloud API secret (unprefixed, pre-2025-07-30)
families.description: Unprefixed 64-byte base64-body API secret, recognized only beside a same-line confluent keyword.
families.note: redact-secret#309 (product PR #667). Scored as policy (no value grammar), like twilio:auth-token.

families.name: API key
families.description: PMAK-prefixed API key: 24 hex bytes, a literal "-", then 34 hex bytes (59-byte body); sent in the X-API-Key header.
families.note: redact-secret#310 (product PR #668) landed on the product main after 0.1.0-beta.6; the pinned published package predates it. The provider page documents only the header, so the grammar is tool-corroborated (T2).
